lines.en: label firsttimesoccer:
scene sky
You know, after being reborn into a world where I’m suddenly expected to fulfill the role of a teacher, I didn’t really expect to be using my {i}free time{/i} to hang out at school as well.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，重生到一个突然要我扮演老师的世界之后，我真没料到自己还会把{i}空闲时间{/i}也花在学校里晃荡。

lines.en: But here I am, drenched in sunlight and making my way over to the soccer field for reasons unbeknownst to even me.
lines.zh: 可我现在就在这儿，浑身浸在阳光里，连我自己都不知道为什么地往足球场走去。

lines.en: I’m not sure what I expect to get out of this exactly, but I do know that at least one of my students is a member of the soccer team, so I'm {i}really{/i} hoping she’s there.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己到底想从中得到什么，但我知道我的学生里至少有一个是足球队的，所以我{i}真的{/i}希望她在。

lines.en: Otherwise, I’ll just wind up looking like some creepy older guy wandering around the premises.
lines.zh: 要不然，我就只能看起来像个在校园里乱晃的猥琐大叔。

lines.en: Which, in all fairness I kind of am.
lines.zh: 说实话，我本来也差不多就是。

lines.en: It’s just significantly {i}less{/i} creepy if I know someone and can fall back on them.
lines.zh: 只是要是我认识这儿的人、能有个靠山，那猥琐程度就会{i}低{/i}很多。

lines.en: Even if...the person I’d be falling on is a foot shorter than me and would likely snap in half from the pressure.
lines.zh: 哪怕……我要靠的那个人比我矮一英尺，而且很可能会被压成两截。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer1
I manage to spot Miku gathering up some rogue soccer balls and shouting things to a group of girls who appear to be heading back to the gym.
lines.zh: 我总算看到了 Miku，她正在把几个散落的足球收拢起来，还朝着一群似乎正要回体育馆的女生喊着什么。

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do and still mildly worried about appearing as a stalker, I make my way over to her.
lines.zh: 不知道还能做什么，又有点担心自己看起来像个跟踪狂，我朝她走了过去。

lines.en: : Hey, Miku. Good morning.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。早上好。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer2
: Heya! Mornin’, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哟！早啊，Sensei！

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer3
: Wait, Sensei?! What are you doin’ over here?! You some kinda stalker now or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei？！您跑这儿来干嘛？！您现在改行当跟踪狂了还是怎么着？

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : No. In fact, I only approached you so I {i}wouldn’t{/i} look like some kind of stalker.
lines.zh: : 不是。事实上，我之所以过来找你，就是{i}不想{/i}让自己看起来像个跟踪狂。

lines.en: : So...you’re stalkin’ me to...{i}not{/i} look like a stalker? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 所以……您跟踪我是为了……{i}不{/i}像个跟踪狂？我搞不懂。

lines.en: : I’m not stalking anyone. I just happened to be in the area and thought I’d come say hi or something.
lines.zh: : 我没有跟踪谁。我只是碰巧在这附近，想着过来打个招呼什么的。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer4
: Works for me! I hereby grant you one Miku Maruyama “Daytime Stalking Pass!”
lines.zh: : 我没意见！我在此授予您一张 Miku Maruyama『白天跟踪通行证』！

lines.en: : In fact, take a whole box of ‘em! I give you permission to show up whenever ya want from this point on!
lines.zh: : 事实上，您干脆拿一整盒去！从现在起，我准许您想什么时候来就什么时候来！

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer5
: How come ya gotta be at school on the weekend, though? Thought all you teachers were out doin’ math problems with each other or somethin’ on those days.
lines.zh: : 不过您周末怎么还得到学校来啊？我还以为老师们那些天都凑一块儿做数学题什么的呢。

lines.en: : Teachers have lives too, you know.
lines.zh: : 老师也有自己的生活，你知道的。

lines.en: : Sure don’t look like it if you’re-
lines.zh: : 看您这样子可不像——

lines.en: : I’m just very good at my job. Can we stop talking about teaching now?
lines.zh: : 我只是工作干得特别好。我们能别聊教学了吗？

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer4
: Heck yeah we can! That kinda stuff always puts me to sleep anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然能！反正那种事一讲我就犯困。

lines.en: : So, you lookin’ to learn about soccer or somethin’? Haven’t really seen ya drop by the field at all and I ain’t buyin’ that you’re just here to say hi.
lines.zh: : 那么，您是想学足球还是怎么的？我从没见您来过球场，您说只是来打个招呼，我可不信。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer6
: Wait a sec! You ain’t here to become the new coach, are you?!
lines.zh: : 等等！您该不会是来当新教练的吧？！

lines.en: : Coach? Absolutely not. I have zero interest in soccer and I {i}really{/i} am only here to say hi.
lines.zh: : 教练？绝对不是。我对足球一点兴趣都没有，而且我{i}真的{/i}只是来打个招呼。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer7
: Guh.
: Guh?
scene mikunewsoccer8
: God! Can’t a girl say “Guh” around here without a teacher jumpin’ down her pants?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！这儿连一个女生说句「呃」，都得有个老师往她裤子里钻吗？！

lines.en: : I think you mean “throat” but please proceed.
lines.zh: : 我想你要说的应该是「嗓子」，不过请继续。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer9
: Sorry for snappin’ at ya, Sensei. It’s just been all downhill since our last coach got knocked up and had to get put on baby-watch or whatever they call it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉冲您发火了，Sensei。只是自从上一任教练被搞大了肚子、得去待产什么的，情况就一路下滑。

lines.en: : I believe that would be “maternity leave.”
lines.zh: : 我想那应该叫「产假」。

lines.en: : I don’t care what it’s called. All I know is that we’re startin’ to fall behind and we were {i}already{/i} havin’ a tough time trainin’ for nationals.
lines.zh: : 我才不管那叫什么。我只知道我们开始落后了，而且备战全国大赛本来就{i}已经{/i}很吃力了。

lines.en: : Nationals? Are you guys really that good?
lines.zh: : 全国大赛？你们真有那么强？

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer10
: Good? No way.
lines.zh: : 强？才不是。

lines.en: : A few of us are pretty awesome- me being one of ‘em of course. But a lot of the girls are like headless chickens out there, Sensei. It’s pure chaos.
lines.zh: : 我们里头有几个还挺厉害的——当然我也算一个。可很多女生在场上就像无头苍蝇，Sensei。纯粹是一片混乱。

lines.en: : I was kinda hopin’ this was gonna be like a sports anime and you were gonna show up and be all like “I used to play soccer before I stepped on a landmine” and then drop knowledge bombs on us.
lines.zh: : 我本来还盼着这会像体育动漫那样，您突然出现，来一句「我以前是踢足球的，直到踩上了地雷」，然后给我们猛灌一堆知识炸弹。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer3
: Oh, crud! Sorry for wordin’ it like that. I’m sure it ain’t easy hearin’ the word “bomb” used so casually after the whole thing with your leg.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟糕！抱歉我这么说。您腿出了那档子事之后，听到「炸弹」这两个字被这么随便地用，肯定不好受。

lines.en: : Again, I know absolutely nothing about soccer and I am mostly confident that I have never stepped on a landmine.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我对足球一无所知，而且我基本可以确信，我从来没踩过地雷。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer11
: Today just keeps gettin’ worse...
lines.zh: : 今天真是越来越糟了……

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer12
: Guess it wouldn’t change much even if I did get my sports anime wish, though.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，就算我真实现了那个体育动漫的愿望，大概也没什么改变。

lines.en: : With the whole space war thing goin’ on, none of us are allowed outside of the barrier anyway.
lines.zh: : 闹着那场太空战争，我们本来就谁都不许走出结界。

lines.en: : With no teams from other prefectures to play, it’s kinda like the entire soccer team is just one giant, headless chicken.
lines.zh: : 没有外县的球队可打，整个足球队就像一只巨大的无头苍蝇。

lines.en: : Do you know any other analogies or is that the only one?
lines.zh: : 你还知道别的比喻吗，还是就这么一个？

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer10
: I don’t even know what an “analogy” is so that’s probably the only one.
lines.zh: : 我连「比喻」是什么都不知道，所以大概就这一个了。

lines.en: I guess the journal thing in my room was right about Miku not being the brightest girl out there.
lines.zh: 看来我房间里那本日志说得没错——Miku 确实不是最聪明的那种女孩。

lines.en: It wouldn’t be fair if she was gifted in both sports {i}and{/i} studies, though. It’s normally just one or the other for people.
lines.zh: 不过要是她运动{i}和{/i}学习都天才，那也太不公平了。人通常只能占一样。

lines.en: Or neither, if you’re really unlucky.
lines.zh: 或者一样都不占，如果你运气实在太差。

lines.en: But hey, at least Miku’s got {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过嘿，至少 Miku 还有{i}一样{/i}。

lines.en: : I guess definitions aren’t really important as long as you’re not failing all of your tests.
lines.zh: : 我想只要你不是所有考试都不及格，定义什么的也不重要。

lines.en: : You’re failing all of your tests, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你所有考试都不及格，是吧？

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer13
: You’re my teacher! Shouldn’t you know?!
lines.zh: : 您是我的老师啊！您不该知道吗？！

lines.en: : Makoto’s doin’ all she can to help me, but there’s only so much room in my brain for all that smart person stuff!
lines.zh: : Makoto 已经在尽力帮我了，可我脑子里能装聪明人那套东西的地方就这么大！

lines.en: : I swear, I really don’t get why she wants to stay friends with me sometimes when I’ve got pretty much nothin’ I can do for her.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，我有时候真搞不懂她为什么还想跟我做朋友——我几乎什么都不能为她做。

lines.en: : You and Makoto are friends?
lines.zh: : 你和 Makoto 是朋友？

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer4
: Best friends, actually! Roommates too. We’re like two peas in a pod if the...pod only had two peas in it? How many peas are normally in a pod?
lines.zh: : 其实是最要好的朋友！还是室友。我们就像同一颗豆荚里的两颗豌豆——如果……那颗豆荚里只有两颗豌豆的话？一颗豆荚里通常有几颗豌豆啊？

lines.en: : I have no idea, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道，Miku。

lines.en: : Some kinda teacher you are. Not knowin’ about peas and showin’ up to soccer practice to stalk the star player.
lines.zh: : 您算哪门子老师啊。连豌豆都不懂，还跑到足球训练场来跟踪明星球员。

lines.en: : Hey, I have unlimited daytime stalking passes. I am allowed to be here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我手上有无限张白天跟踪通行证。我有权在这儿。

lines.en: : Didn’t say ya weren’t. I think it’s great that ya wanna spend so much time around young girls. Means you’re still in touch with your youthful side.
lines.zh: : 我又没说您没权。我觉得您愿意花这么多时间待在小姑娘身边挺好的，说明您还保持着年轻的一面。

lines.en: : Yup. That is exactly what that means.
lines.zh: : 对。就是这个意思。

lines.en: : You like any kinda sports at all, Sensei? Baseball? Tennis? Hermit crab racing?
lines.zh: : Sensei，您到底喜欢什么运动没有啊？棒球？网球？寄居蟹赛跑？

lines.en: : Not really. I’ve always- wait, what was that last one?
lines.zh: : 不太喜欢。我一直都——等等，最后那个是什么？

lines.en: : Hm? Tennis?
lines.zh: : 嗯？网球？

lines.en: : No, the...actually, forget it. I don’t like any sports.
lines.zh: : 不，那个……算了，当我没说。我什么运动都不喜欢。

lines.en: : In fact...I don’t really like anything now that I actually think about it.
lines.zh: : 事实上……现在认真想想，我好像什么都不喜欢。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer3
: Well then how the heck do ya look all muscley and stuff? If ya didn’t just tell me you’re some kinda couch potato, I’d think you were workin’ out all day every day!
lines.zh: : 那您这一身肌肉是怎么来的啊？要是您没刚告诉我您是个沙发土豆，我还以为您天天都在健身呢！

lines.en: : This is just how I am, I guess. I’m sure your looks wouldn’t change much either if you just...dropped out of the team or something.
lines.zh: : 我想我天生就这样。我敢说，就算你……退出球队什么的，你的样子也不会有多大变化。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer14
: Miku Maruyama droppin’ out of the soccer team? No way. There’s a better chance of you findin’ the guy responsible for blowin’ off your leg.
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama 退出足球队？不可能。那还不如指望您找着那个把您腿炸飞的家伙呢。

lines.en: : I love soccer. I love the rush. Runnin’ around with my friends...goin’ out to family restaurants after practice...
lines.zh: : 我爱足球。我爱那种冲刺的快感。和朋友们一起跑来跑去……训练完去家庭餐厅搓一顿……

lines.en: : Even cleanin’ up all the balls is kinda fun when ya get to do it with people ya like bein’ around.
lines.zh: : 就算是收拾这些球，只要和喜欢待在一起的人一起做，也挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Well, I am very sorry for standing between you and your affinity for balls.
lines.zh: : 嗯，真是抱歉，我挡在你和你的球之间了。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer15
: You ain’t standin’ between anythin’, Sensei! I like bein’ around you too!
lines.zh: : 您什么都没挡，Sensei！我也喜欢跟您待在一起啊！

lines.en: : If I didn’t, I woulda asked you to leave a while ago.
lines.zh: : 要是不喜欢，我早就请您走了。

lines.en: : Besides, the fact that you’re still here makes me confident that I can get ya to agree to bein’ our new coach!
lines.zh: : 再说，您到现在还没走，说明我大概能说服您当我们新教练！

lines.en: : No.
scene mikunewsoccer13
: At least think about it, would ya?! If we don’t get a new coach by the end of the season, the school is gonna disband us!
lines.zh: : 至少考虑一下嘛，行不行？！要是这赛季结束前还找不着新教练，学校就要把我们解散了！

lines.en: : Are they really?
lines.zh: : 真的会吗？

lines.en: : Well...they haven’t come out and said that! But that’s what would happen if this was a sports anime!
lines.zh: : 嗯……他们是没明说过！不过要是这是体育动漫的话，就会这么演！

lines.en: : You really need to stop equating your real life sports club to the clubs in cartoons, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你真的该别把你现实里的体育社团跟动画片里的社团划等号了，Miku。

lines.en: : Though...I definitely wouldn’t be surprised if your club {i}was{/i} disbanded for the reasons you mentioned.
lines.zh: : 不过……要是你们社团{i}真的{/i}因为你说的那些原因被解散，我一点都不会惊讶。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are like...health hazards or something if all of you are here over the weekend unsupervised.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，你们这么多人周末待在这儿没人看着，肯定有什么……安全隐患之类的。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer12
: It ain’t like we need supervision. Heck, it ain’t even like we need {i}coaching{/i} on account of the lack of teams for us to play against.
lines.zh: : 我们又不需要人看着。见鬼，反正也没别的队跟我们打，我们连{i}教练{/i}都不需要。

lines.en: : We just need somebody who doesn’t mind occasionally bein’ around a bunch of girls in tight shorts to sign their name on a sheet of paper so we can keep doin’ what we love doin’.
lines.zh: : 我们只需要有个人，不介意偶尔待在一群穿紧身短裤的女生旁边，在一张纸上签个名，好让我们继续做我们爱做的事。

lines.en: : That really should have been your pitch from the get go. That sounds a lot more enticing.
lines.zh: : 你从一开始就该这么推销。这样听起来诱人多了。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer16
: Just wait ‘til ya see my vice captain. She’s got thighs so crazy they’ll give ya nightmares. Abs so hard they’ll...give ya nightmares too!
lines.zh: : 您等着见我的副队长吧。她那双腿，疯得能让您做噩梦。腹肌硬得也会……让您做噩梦！

lines.en: : What I’m gettin’ at is that you’re gonna have a bunch of nightmares, Sensei! So you better be prepared!
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，您会做一大堆噩梦，Sensei！所以您最好做好准备！

lines.en: As much as I like the idea of surrounding myself with other versions of Miku...I really don’t know if I’ll have the time to do this whole coaching thing.
lines.zh: 虽然我很喜欢被一堆 Miku 的翻版包围这个点子……但我真不知道自己有没有时间干教练这档子事。

lines.en: There’s no way it will be as easy as just signing my name on a sheet of paper and staring at thighs.
lines.zh: 这不可能只是签个名、盯着大腿看那么轻松。

lines.en: Especially not when even keeping up with this conversation has been harder than normal for me.
lines.zh: 尤其连跟上这段对话对我来说都比平时费劲。

lines.en: : I...don’t know, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer4
: Then I’ll just have to keep botherin’ ya!
lines.zh: : 那我就一直烦您好了！

lines.en: : You do plan on comin’ back, right? I’m sure I ain’t alone in thinkin’ that a boy bein’ around might help some of the girls kick it into overdrive, if you know what I’m sayin’.
lines.zh: : 您打算再来的，对吧？我敢说不止我一个人觉得，有个男的在旁边，说不定能让一些女生干劲爆表——您懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : I want that to be a compliment, but I’m pretty sure it’s because almost all of the other men around here are gone.
lines.zh: : 我倒希望这是夸我，但我挺确定，只是因为这附近的其他男人几乎都跑光了。

lines.en: : That just means you’ve got more options to choose from! Tons of young, spunky soccer players- ripe for the pickin’!
lines.zh: : 那只是说明您有更多选择！一大堆年轻又活力四射的足球运动员——随您挑！

lines.en: : For someone who loves being around her friends so much, you sure don’t seem to have a problem with handing them off to someone twice their age.
lines.zh: : 一个这么爱和朋友们待在一起的人，把她们交给一个年纪比她们大一倍的家伙，倒是一点心理负担都没有。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer17
: Think of ‘em as bargaining chips, Sensei. If you start dependin’ on ‘em and then I cut off your supply...you’ll {i}have{/i} to be our coach.
lines.zh: : 您就把她们当筹码吧，Sensei。要是您开始依赖她们，我再把货源一断……您就{i}非得{/i}当我们教练不可了。

lines.en: : And that’s the bottom line, cause Miku Maruyama said so.
lines.zh: : 这就是底线，因为 Miku Maruyama 说的。

lines.en: : Miku.
lines.zh: : Miku。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer7
: Guh. Don’t say it. It’s hard enough to stay motivated when all ya can do is run around in circles like some kinda-
lines.zh: : 呃。别说。光是能做的就只有绕着圈子跑、像某种——就已经够难保持干劲了。

lines.en: : If you mention headless chickens again, I am going to deflate every soccer ball on this field.
lines.zh: : 你要是再提无头苍蝇，我就把这块场上每个足球都放气。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer13
: Hold on there, Bill Belichick! You think you can just walk onto {i}my{/i} soccer field and start touchin’ {i}my{/i} balls?! You ain’t earned the right!
lines.zh: : 等一下，Bill Belichick！您以为您能大摇大摆走进{i}我{/i}的足球场，就开始摸{i}我{/i}的球吗？！您还没那个资格呢！

lines.en: : That’s fine, because hearing you word it that way killed any desire I would have possibly had to do it anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为你这么一说，我本来可能有的那点欲望也全没了。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer17
: Mwahahah! Miku Maruyama wins again! A true champion of justice and soccer!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈！Miku Maruyama 又赢了！正义与足球的真正冠军！

lines.en: : But not Nationals.
lines.zh: : 但全国大赛可不是。

lines.en: : You know. Since you’ll never be able to make it, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。我是说，反正你们永远也打不进去。

lines.en: scene mikunewsoccer18
: Gimme back that friggin’ day pass.
lines.zh: : 把那该死的日间通行证还我。

lines.en: scene black
Miku revokes my box of imaginary day passes, but that’s okay.
lines.zh: Miku 收回了我那盒想象出来的日间通行证，不过没关系。

lines.en: Because even if I have no intention of becoming the coach of this team, I still plan on showing up again.
lines.zh: 因为就算我根本没打算当这支球队的教练，我还是打算再来。

lines.en: Just like how I plan to learn more about Miku and ultimately use that as leverage to find my way into her extremely tight shorts.
lines.zh: 就像我也打算多了解 Miku，最终以此为筹码，好钻进她那条紧得要命的短裤里。

lines.en: That still seems miles away at this point, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这在目前看来还遥不可及。

lines.en: But something about seeing her sprint toward her goals makes me want to sprint toward mine...
lines.zh: 但看着她朝自己的目标冲刺的样子，不知怎么也让我想朝自己的目标冲刺……

lines.en: Even if they’re on the opposite side of the world.
lines.zh: 哪怕它们在世界的两端。

lines.en: As I turn around to leave the field, a ball crashes into my back with so much force that it almost knocks me over.
lines.zh: 我转身离开球场时，一颗球以巨大的力道砸在我背上，差点把我撞倒。

lines.en: I think about glancing behind me to see whether or not this was intentional-
lines.zh: 我想过回头看一眼，判断这是不是故意的——

lines.en: But the sudden addition of Miku’s childish laughter blending in with the pre-existing medley of vigorous youth answers that question better than any glance possibly could.
lines.zh: 但 Miku 孩子气的笑声突然混进了那片本来就有的、朝气蓬勃的青春交响里，比任何一瞥都更好地回答了这个问题。

lines.en: $ firsttimesoccerfield = True
$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
